what: Mistake: the D43 fix request (job 20261024-045548-7qht) let a recorded passing check count as run, but neither it nor the prompt says the verifier must list that command in the criterion's commands field; job 20261024-033935-c4w4's verifier cited the recorded results in its evidence text with commands empty and was rejected again.
why: When a rule reads a structured field, the instruction to the agent should name that field; the reader could check that a prompt instruction and the rule judging it refer to the same field.
